_comment: MineScripture curated levity pool. 100% human-written/curated, served only when Gloo classifies a moment's tone as 'light' (comedic deaths and pratfalls). Never presented as Scripture — the Presenter uses a distinct light format with no verse frame and no attribution line.

quips.text: Pride goes before a fall. So does standing too close to the edge.
Even Balaam's donkey would have seen that cactus.
Consider the lilies of the field... they never hug cacti.
Jonah spent three days inside a fish. You spent three seconds inside your own wheat farm.
Let there be light. Preferably a torch, before you dig straight down.
Noah prepared for forty days of flood. You were defeated by one pond.
Forty years in the wilderness, and the Israelites never once fell into their own pit.
A cheerful heart is good medicine. So is not punching a zombie barehanded.
The walls of Jericho fell. So, apparently, did you.
David faced Goliath with five smooth stones. You faced a creeper with a carrot.
Be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slower to step on magma.
The Red Sea parted for Moses. Your lava lake made no such promises.
Wise men still seek Him. Wiser men look down before they walk.
Daniel survived the lions' den. Your own wolf just wanted a bone.
Man does not live on bread alone — but eating something before a fight wouldn't have hurt.
